newsitem.title: JAPAN: Qatar ups Apr Land, cuts Marine term price - traders.
newsitem.headline: Qatar ups Apr Land, cuts Marine term price - traders.

text.p: Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) has raised its price formula for April-lifting Qatar Land crude oil by one cent per barrel and cut its price formula for April-lifting Qatar Marine by seven cents per barrel, traders in Tokyo said on Tuesday.

According to the QGPC formula, April Qatar Land was calculated at Oman plus 41 cents per barrel, which translated into $17.94 per barrel, and April Qatar Marine at Oman plus 19 cents per barrel, or $17.72 per barrel.
March Qatar Land was set at Oman plus 40 cents per barrel, or $19.50 per barrel, and March Qatar Marine at Oman plus 26 cents per barrel, or $19.36 per barrel.
Qatar's retroactive price formula is based on the official selling price of Oman issued monthly by Oman's Ministry of Petroleum and Mines.
